label: weapon-loss-overkill
title: Duel with confirmed weapon loss
intent: Replacement for the 400-point loss attempt in S-15: apply 4000 to the same laser, then verify that its projectiles cease while the other weapons keep fighting.

hardpoints.label: frigate/laser-fl
hardpoints.source: FoC HARDPOINTS.XML Fire_Range_Distance 1100; SPACEUNITSFRIGATES.XML Nebulon_B_Frigate Targeting_Priority_Set Frigate.

notes: Record-only: no quantitative movement or ability expectation is established in docs/behaviour.
Reproduce with recorder seed 12345, pre-staging frame 300, tick zero frame 345, logical cadence 1/30 s; AI suspended and fog revealed.
Record alive, pos.xyz, fwd.xyz, hull and shield each tick. See README.md for measured usability and reproduction.

Original recordings (P2-06, FoC debug build, quick-loaded map, seed 12345, tick 0 at frame 345): three runs agree bit for bit in every field, so the original's spread is 0. Each tolerance is the larger of that spread and the conversion bound (docs/traces.md): positions are whole numbers held for the whole recording, exact in binary32 and in Q24, so 0; the Tartan's hull (from 750) and both ships' shields (from 700 and 800) go off whole numbers below 1024, where binary32 steps by 2^-14: 1024 raw (the frigate's hull holds 5400); fwd allows 16 raw units as in S-01: yaw holds whole degrees and pitch holds at most 0.516 degree off whole (binary32 step 2^-24 degree, 0.02 raw per component), so the bound stays 15.80 raw, below 16; shots are ignored because the laser fires in bursts whose gaps vary (101 to 110 ticks) with random recharge draws the scenario does not control, and hull and shield follow the same fire times, so a remake matches them only when it reproduces those draws (behaviour, not conversion). Accumulated integration error of the remake's own damage arithmetic is not in these bounds and needs its own evidence.
Nebulon-B DEFEND autofire is not enabled by staging; the quick-load Rebel owner is nonhuman without an AI player. This does not reproduce the human toggle state.

HD-10 expectation assessed manually: the front-left laser fires before tick 500 and emits no projectiles after scripted loss; other weapons and the duel continue. HD-02: the scripted hardpoint hit itself leaves hull unchanged.

Replacement candidate for S-15 hardpoint loss: a 400-point hit did not stop the laser. This case raises only the scripted hit to 4000; usability requires observed fire before tick 500 and none after it.
Read-only DEFEND probes write active/autofire/ready to the private game log at ticks 1, 499, 501, 530 and 800; no ability toggle is issued.
